text.en:
<stasis/>Freezing enemies grants 11% Class Ability Energy per enemy frozen.

Casting your Class Ability instantly <stasis/>Freezes enemies within an <pve 8.5 /> <pvp [5] /> meter radius and increases Melee Lunge Distance by 2.5 meters for 1.2 seconds. Enemy Players within 5 to 8 meters receive x50 <stasis/>Slow stacks for 3? seconds.

Successfully freezing a target with this ability grants x5 <stasis/>Frost Armor.
